# ML Guide

> A comprehensive machine learning guide covering optimization algorithms, neural networks, and training methodologies for modern ML practitioners.

ML Guide provides focused documentation on machine learning fundamentals and advanced techniques. The site emphasizes practical understanding of optimization algorithms and deep learning concepts essential for training effective models.

## Key Topics

- Gradient Descent
- Stochastic Gradient Descent
- Batch Gradient Descent
- Mini-Batch Gradient Descent
- Optimization Algorithms
- Artificial Neural Networks
- Deep Learning
- Machine Learning Training
- Logistic Regression
- Online Machine Learning

## Optimization Algorithms

- [Optimization - Gradient Descent](https://linked0.gitbooks.io/mlguide/content/gradient-descent-algorithm.html): Guide to Gradient Descent optimization algorithms for machine learning training
